integrity: The proof is self-contained; the embedded standard-library checker supplies exact finite-state and rational algebra corroboration, not an infinite computational certificate.
scientific_limitations: The result is for unweighted wheels under uniform feasible-edge greedy matching; the secondary exponential radius is not optimized. Older matching literature is incompletely available, so historical priority has a residual risk. No independent scientific audit was performed.
title: A sharp exponential hub-survival law for random greedy wheel matchings
